egress.terms: 1000 GB/month included. Metered and small; this is the binding limit, not the 150 GB.

record.tooling: Jailed SSH explicitly 'for rsync and the likes', plus DirectAdmin, plus NextCloud optionally available. rclone sftp works against jailed SSH if the jail exposes the storage path.
record.chaining: Application-gated, so not repeatable: signups go through a Google-Form review and the host states users with '~1-100 comments and that have recently signed up can expect to be rejected'. The filter targets the several-accounts pattern.
record.limits_note: Fixed storage quota is 150 GB with 1 TB per month bandwidth.
record.reliability_note: The offer is unreachable with endpoints /, /storagebox/, and /storagebox/signup/ returning HTTP 530 origin unreachable on 2026-10-21.
